2. Daily Summary
I inspected the Spring Creek Station (Brookstone) job site on October 21, 2026. Four workers signed in, two under Virgilio and two under Chuy. The YSD gang box is on site with QR code sheets posted for the YSD manuals and the clinic locations, and it holds fasteners for the powder-actuated tools, ear plugs, self-retracting lifelines (yo-yos), and harnesses. The interior is coming along, with finished walls, control joints, set door frames, and circular metal framing at the ceiling. Finishers cleaned their tools and prepared their material, and temporary power was provided on site. The GC provides fire extinguishers located around the site and fans all around the site to keep workers cool. A trash buggy was in use to clean the site and a cleaner was on site. Workers photographed were in full PPE, and a framer worked from a scissor lift wearing a full-body harness while the exterior work area was marked off with caution tape and cones.
3. Safety Measures Verified
PPE — Workers photographed in full PPE: hard hats, safety glasses, high-visibility vests, and gloves.
Safety Postings — QR code sheets for the YSD Safety Manual and SDS booklet and the Occucare clinic locations posted on the gang box.
Fall Protection — Self-retracting lifelines, snap hooks, and harnesses available in the gang box; framer on the scissor lift wearing a full-body harness.
Hearing Protection — Ear plugs available in the gang box.
Fire Extinguishers — Provided by the GC and located around the site, with one also on the scissor lift platform.
Temporary Power — Panel padlocked, DANGER energized equipment sign posted, and a guard frame around the panel.
Ventilation — Fans provided by the GC all around the site to keep workers cool.
Housekeeping — Trash buggy in use to clean the site, and a cleaner on site.
Work Area Control — Caution tape and cones marking off the exterior equipment area.
